title: QuestMaster
body:
# ✨ QuestMaster • Missions & Rewards 🎯

Bring adventures to your server with QuestMaster! Create custom missions 🗂️, challenge your players 🎯, and reward them with unique items 🗡️, XP ⭐, and commands 

---
## ✨ Features:
- ✅ **Custom Missions** 🏹: Individual, timer-based ⏱️, or global 🌐
- ✅ **Rewards** 🎁: Items 🗡️, experience ⭐, and commands 💻 – including custom items 🛠️!
- ✅ **Timers** ⏱️: Integration with Voiid Countdown Timer for time-limited missions ⏳
- ✅ **Full Customization** 🛠️: All messages 💬, GUI titles 🖌️, and effects 🎇 configurable in config.yml
---

## ⚡ Main Commands:
```
/missions – Open your mission menu 🗂️
```
```
/questmaster – Displays the QuestMaster help menu 🔄
```
---

**📜 Requirements:**
[VCT plugin](https://modrinth.com/datapack/voiid-countdown-timer) ⏱️ for timer global missions. 

---
🌐 For more information, visit the [QuestMaster Wiki](https://qm0-1.gitbook.io/questmaster-docs/).
